jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer (Claude Code, Cursor)
jobs.description: About Nordavo Nordavo connects Dutch tech companies with engineers in Bangalore. Our clients range from SaaS companies building their own product to agencies building AI systems for their customers. You work from our office in Indiranagar, on our payroll, as a full member of the clients team. We handle HR and everything around it. More about us: https://nordavo.nl The role Most Dutch tech teams dont write their code by hand anymore. They build with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and they need engineers who can make those agents do real work. Not demos. Systems that keep running when nobody is watching. Depending on the client, that means product features, internal tools or automations behind the scenes. You wont get a ticket with every step written out. You get a problem, some context and a lead who expects you to figure out the rest and come back with a plan. What youll do Build agents, workflows, features and internal tools with Claude Code, Cursor and other agent harnesses Design the setup around each agent: tools, context, permissions, memory and checks Work on the layer underneath: servers, databases, APIs, integrations, RAG and vector databases Set up evals and logging, and find out why an agent went wrong Review what the agent wrote before it goes live. You own the result, not the AI Join the team’s stand-ups and keep your lead updated without being asked Skills we look for You build with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or a similar agent every day, and you can show what you built with it You know how to extend your harness: MCP servers, subagents, hooks, skills, rules and custom commands. You’ve set these up yourself, not just read about them You fix agent problems with context, tools and feedback loops, not only with a better prompt You understand what the agent produces. You can read the code, spot when it’s wrong and explain every line if someone asks Solid basics: Git, pull requests, APIs, databases and debugging You think about security. You know where secrets go, what permissions an agent should not have and what happens if it fails halfway You keep an eye on cost and speed. A workflow that burns tokens for no reason is a bad workflow 2 to 5 years of experience as a developer or engineer How you work You ask questions until a task is clear, and you say so when you disagree You flag problems early and give honest estimates You write short, clear updates without being asked You take ownership of what you build, also when it breaks Nice to have n8n, Supabase, Next.js or similar Experience working with European or US teams A public repo, blog or video about how you work with agents Nordavo Groningen Bangalore • Indiranagar office • https://nordavo.nl 2-5 Yrs Nextjs, Artificial Intelligence, GIT, DBMS, Python, MCP, Vector, Coding

jobs.title: Sr. Solutions Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Description Hungry, Humble, Honest, with a Heart. The Opportunity Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on. We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents. In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person. You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right. Your Role Design, build, and maintain Python software that deploys, configures, and validates Nutanix private and hybrid cloud environments. Build agentic workflows around that software, including prompt engineering, agent skill and tool development, and the evaluation harnesses that show a workflow works before we rely on it. Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. Most of what you deliver should be deterministic and repeatable, with agents used where the problem involves ambiguity, synthesis, or design judgment. Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, and help raise the teams practice as the tooling changes. Build and operate cloud native, automated pipelines, covering containerized workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, so that builds and validations run without manual intervention. Automate validation as part of building the feature, and catch regressions before a release reaches a customer. Analyze failures, determine root cause, and drive fixes to closure. Demo your work to Solutions Architects, product teams, and customers, and write documentation that other people can actually use. Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues. What Youll Bring Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or a related field. 6+ years building production software, with real depth in at least one role. Python is required. We are looking for production-grade depth and the ability to own a Python codebase that other people depend on. Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic tooling: prompt engineering, agent skills or tool definitions, and testing and evaluating non-deterministic systems. Good judgment about where automation should be deterministic and where an agent adds value, and the discipline to keep the trusted path in code. Strong fundamentals in Object-Oriented Programming, algorithms, data structures, and problem solving. Cloud native delivery experience: containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes) and automated CI/CD pipelines. Experience working against REST APIs and building infrastructure as code. Experience with a "systems" product such as storage, virtualization, networking, databases, or operating systems. Skill in debugging complex distributed applications. jobs.description: Company Overview As a leading global professional services firm, we sit at the intersection of strategy, technology, and industry expertise. Our Advisory practice partners with the worlds most influential financial institutions to solve their most complex challenges. We are currently expanding our AI & Data Engineering powerhouse to support Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in the Banking, Financial Services (BFS) sector. We don’t just advise; we build, deploy, and scale the future of intelligent finance. Role Context The Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is a high-impact, hybrid role that bridges the gap between deep technical engineering and strategic business consulting. Unlike traditional backend engineers, you will be embedded directly with our BFSI GCC clients, working on the front lines to productionize Generative AI solutions. You will be responsible for moving AI from "proof of concept" to "industrial-grade" within highly regulated environments, ensuring that every model deployed creates measurable alpha or operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Rapid Prototyping & Deployment: Design and build production-ready AI applications, moving from initial client requirements to MVP in weeks, not months. Architecture Design: Develop scalable RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures and multi-agent systems tailored for complex BFSI datasets. Client Integration: Work on-site at client GCCs to integrate AI solutions into existing legacy infrastructures and modern cloud environments. Stakeholder Management: Translate complex technical AI concepts into business value for C-suite stakeholders and functional heads. Operational Excellence: Ensure all AI deployments meet the rigorous security, latency, and reliability standards required by global financial institutions. Technical Qualifications Generative AI & DevOps Deep experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) including GPT-4, Claude, and Llama, with a focus on fine-tuning and prompt engineering, guardrails. Proven ability to build Autonomous Agents and multi-agent orchestrations using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen . Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS or GCP, including containerization, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm charts and production deployment of scalable AI applications. Domain Qualifications: BFSI Experience working with core banking systems, payment gateways, or high-throughput financial ledgers, with working knowledge of BFSI regulatory and compliance considerations. Also ability to translate business requirement to technical implementation. 3-7 Yrs Devops, Kubernetes, AWS, Tensorflow, Deployment, Microsoft Azure, System, Generation

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer / AI Architect (LLMs | MCP | Text-to-SQL)
jobs.description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer / AI Architect with strong hands-on expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Text-to-SQL solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade AI applications, including LLM-powered systems, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, model fine-tuning, and natural-language-to-SQL solutions. This role requires a combination of strong architectural skills and practical implementation experience. The candidate should be capable of defining AI architecture, developing production-ready solutions, optimizing models, and providing technical leadership to the engineering team. Key Responsibilities 1. LLM Architecture & Generative AI Design and implement end-to-end LLM-based application architectures. Work with GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and other open-source models. Develop agentic AI workflows, multi-agent systems, tool calling, and orchestration. Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. Optimize LLM applications for accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost. 2. Model Training & Fine-Tuning Fine-tune LLMs using LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, and other parameter-efficient techniques. Work with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, and TRL. Develop training datasets, synthetic data generation, and evaluation pipelines. Optimize model inference using quantization, distillation, batching, and GPU acceleration. Experience with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, or FSDP is preferred. 3. MCP & AI Tool Integration Design and develop MCP servers and MCP clients. Integrate LLM applications with enterprise databases, APIs, document repositories, and external tools. Build secure tool-calling mechanisms and agent integrations. Implement authentication, authorization, audit logging, and data-access controls. Ensure secure AI interactions and protection against prompt injection and data leakage. 4. Text-to-SQL & AI-Powered Data Intelligence Design and develop Natural Language to SQL (Text-to-SQL) applications. Enable users to query enterprise databases using natural language. Work with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, SQL Server, or similar databases. Implement schema linking, query validation, semantic layers, and SQL generation. Build query execution, self-correction, and result-explanation mechanisms. Implement read-only access, data security, and query-cost controls. 5. AI Evaluation, MLOps & Deployment Develop evaluation frameworks to measure LLM accuracy and performance. Implement LLM monitoring, tracing, prompt versioning, and observability. Deploy AI applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Work with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and scalable inference infrastructure. Implement responsible AI practices, security guardrails, and data governance. 6. Technical Leadership Own AI architecture and technical implementation. Review code and provide architectural guidance. Mentor AI/ML engineers and software developers. Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams. Identify emerging AI technologies and implement practical solutions. Required Skills & Qualifications 5+ years of software engineering / ML engineering experience. 3+ years of hands-on experience in LLMs and Generative AI. Strong expertise in Python programming. Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, and function/tool calling. Experience with LLM fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, or DPO. Strong knowledge of PyTorch and Hugging Face ecosystem. Hands-on experience with MCP servers/clients or equivalent AI tool-integration frameworks. Proven experience in building Text-to-SQL or Natural Language Analytics solutions. Strong SQL and database knowledge. Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, pgvector, or Chroma. Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of LLM evaluation, model optimization, security, and production deployment. Good to Have Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or OpenAI Agents SDK. Experience with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, or distributed GPU training. Knowledge of semantic layers such as dbt, Cube, or LookML. Experience with enterprise AI solutions in Healthcare, Finance, or other regulated domains. Open-source contributions or research experience in Generative AI / NLP. Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, NLP, or a related field. Preferred Candidate Profile Strong combination of AI architecture and hands-on development experience. Experience delivering production-grade LLM applications. Ability to independently design and implement complex AI solutions. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor engineering teams. 4-9 Yrs Machine, MCP, Python, Artificial Intelligence, Aiml, Large, Ml, Microsoft Azure

jobs.description: About Guidesly Guidesly is the first mobile app connecting anglers to our deep network of trusted fishing guides. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary You will be a core engineer on the AI intelligence layer of an enterprise-grade AI application. Your day-to-day work spans designing and building LLM-powered pipelines, agentic reasoning workflows, semantic retrieval systems, and knowledge graph integrations that serve real business users at scale. You write Python every day. You are responsible not just for building AI features but for ensuring they work reliably and measurably in production not just in demos. Key Responsibilities Design and build natural language to SQL (NL2SQL) pipelines schema grounding techniques, few-shot prompt construction, SQL validation and sanitisation, guardrail enforcement, query explanation generation, and robust error recovery for malformed or ambiguous queries Build and maintain LangGraph-based agentic workflows — state machine design for multi-step reasoning, tool-use orchestration, memory and context management, human-in-the-loop interruption patterns, and agent output validation Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and graph-enhanced RAG (GraphRAG) systems — chunking strategies, embedding model selection and evaluation, hybrid retrieval (dense + sparse), reranking, entity traversal over graph databases, and grounded answer synthesis Design and maintain knowledge graph schemas for business domain semantics — node and relationship type definitions, traversal patterns, semantic similarity scoring, and integration with vector search for combined retrieval Build and operate LLM evaluation pipelines — RAGAS metrics (faithfulness, answer relevance, context recall), LLM-as-judge patterns, custom domain-specific quality metrics, regression testing on prompt changes, and hallucination rate monitoring in production Optimise LLM API usage across Vertex AI and Gemini — prompt caching, model tiering (Flash vs Pro selection criteria), context compression, cost attribution per feature, quota management, and graceful fallback strategies Implement vector embedding pipelines end-to-end — document chunking, embedding generation (text-embedding-gecko or equivalent), index construction and maintenance in AlloyDB pgvector and Vertex AI Vector Search, and scheduled freshness updates as source data changes Write clean, async FastAPI endpoints that expose AI capabilities to frontend and downstream services, with proper streaming support, error handling, and OpenAPI documentation Skill Requirements: Python — 5+ years of production-grade engineering: async / await, Pydantic, type hints, modular package design, pytest, and clean separation of concerns; not just notebook scripting LangChain or LangGraph — production experience building chains, agents, or state machines that handle real-world edge cases and fail gracefully; demonstrable shipped systems, not tutorials LLM APIs — Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic; deep practical understanding of context windows, token budgets, structured output enforcement (JSON schema, function calling), and cost optimisation strategies RAG architectures — chunking strategies, embedding model evaluation, retrieval quality measurement (precision, recall, MRR), reranking approaches, and hybrid search implementation SQL — fluent in complex query writing: joins, window functions, CTEs, subqueries; must be comfortable reading and writing BigQuery and PostgreSQL dialect SQL without assistance Vector search — hands-on production experience with at least one: pgvector, Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, or ChromaDB; including index configuration, ANN parameter tuning, and embedding dimension trade-offs Prompt engineering — systematic, evidence-based approach: few-shot design, chain-of-thought prompting, output structuring, negative example inclusion, prompt versioning, and iterative evaluation methodology Must Have Skills: Python LangChain MySQL Prompt Engineering 8-12 Yrs Engineering, MySQL, Python, Artificial Intelligence
